Also known as MapMalawi Dzaleka Mapping Project.
A MapMalawi initiative that combined drones,
training to document buildings and essential
Waiting in Dzaleka Refugee Camp: Agency through Self- and Community
The Dzaleka Mapping Project was MapMalawi's first
project. It aimed to create open geospatial data
and other services in a densely populated settlement
MapMalawi was founded in December 2020 by Ndapile
Mkuwu and Zola Manyungwa, Malawian YouthMappers
alumni with experience in drone and geospatial
The project used authorised drone flights to capture
imagery at approximately three centimetres per pixel.
